free_text_notes.physician_note: 53-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia, admitted 5/11 with small right cerebellar infarct. NIHSS improved from 6 to 2.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. Patient's potassium was mildly low on day 2 of admission but was corrected with an oral supplement. It was rechecked on day 3 and returned to the normal range.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and husband to review the discharge plan. Patient asked to move the neurology clinic appointment; rebooked within 14 days of discharge.
